targets.expr:
sum_over_time(
  {namespace="cilium", container="hubble-flows"} |= "\"flow\":"
  | json verdict="flow.verdict", dir="flow.traffic_direction", e="flow.aggregate.egress_flow_count", i="flow.aggregate.ingress_flow_count", ep="flow.egress_allowed_by[0].name", ip="flow.ingress_allowed_by[0].name", src_ns="flow.source.namespace", dst_ns="flow.destination.namespace", src_pod="flow.source.pod_name", dst_pod="flow.destination.pod_name", src_labels="flow.source.labels", dst_labels="flow.destination.labels", src_names="flow.source_names", dst_names="flow.destination_names", src_ip="flow.IP.source", dst_ip="flow.IP.destination", tcp="flow.l4.TCP.destination_port", udp="flow.l4.UDP.destination_port", icmp="flow.l4.ICMPv4.type"
  | label_format policy=`{{ or .ep .ip }}`, events=`{{ add (int (or .e "0")) (int (or .i "0")) }}`, port=`{{ if .tcp }}TCP/{{ .tcp }}{{ else if .udp }}UDP/{{ .udp }}{{ else if .icmp }}ICMP/{{ .icmp }}{{ end }}`, src_names=`{{ regexReplaceAll "[\\[\\]\"]" .src_names "" }}`, dst_names=`{{ regexReplaceAll "[\\[\\]\"]" .dst_names "" }}`
  | label_format source=`{{ if .src_ns }}{{ .src_ns }}{{ if .src_pod }}/{{ .src_pod }}{{ end }}{{ else if .src_names }}{{ .src_names }}{{ else if contains "reserved:host" .src_labels }}host{{ else if contains "reserved:remote-node" .src_labels }}remote-node{{ else }}{{ .src_ip }}{{ end }}`, destination=`{{ if .dst_ns }}{{ .dst_ns }}{{ if .dst_pod }}/{{ .dst_pod }}{{ end }}{{ else if .dst_names }}{{ .dst_names }}{{ else if contains "reserved:host" .dst_labels }}host{{ else if contains "reserved:remote-node" .dst_labels }}remote-node{{ else }}{{ .dst_ip }}{{ end }}`
  | keep verdict, dir, source, destination, port, policy, events
  | unwrap events [$__range]
)

max_over_time(
  {namespace="cilium", container="hubble-flows"} |= "\"flow\":"
  | json verdict="flow.verdict", dir="flow.traffic_direction", e="flow.aggregate.egress_flow_count", i="flow.aggregate.ingress_flow_count", ep="flow.egress_allowed_by[0].name", ip="flow.ingress_allowed_by[0].name", src_ns="flow.source.namespace", dst_ns="flow.destination.namespace", src_pod="flow.source.pod_name", dst_pod="flow.destination.pod_name", src_labels="flow.source.labels", dst_labels="flow.destination.labels", src_names="flow.source_names", dst_names="flow.destination_names", src_ip="flow.IP.source", dst_ip="flow.IP.destination", tcp="flow.l4.TCP.destination_port", udp="flow.l4.UDP.destination_port", icmp="flow.l4.ICMPv4.type"
  | label_format policy=`{{ or .ep .ip }}`, events=`{{ add (int (or .e "0")) (int (or .i "0")) }}`, port=`{{ if .tcp }}TCP/{{ .tcp }}{{ else if .udp }}UDP/{{ .udp }}{{ else if .icmp }}ICMP/{{ .icmp }}{{ end }}`, src_names=`{{ regexReplaceAll "[\\[\\]\"]" .src_names "" }}`, dst_names=`{{ regexReplaceAll "[\\[\\]\"]" .dst_names "" }}`
  | label_format source=`{{ if .src_ns }}{{ .src_ns }}{{ if .src_pod }}/{{ .src_pod }}{{ end }}{{ else if .src_names }}{{ .src_names }}{{ else if contains "reserved:host" .src_labels }}host{{ else if contains "reserved:remote-node" .src_labels }}remote-node{{ else }}{{ .src_ip }}{{ end }}`, destination=`{{ if .dst_ns }}{{ .dst_ns }}{{ if .dst_pod }}/{{ .dst_pod }}{{ end }}{{ else if .dst_names }}{{ .dst_names }}{{ else if contains "reserved:host" .dst_labels }}host{{ else if contains "reserved:remote-node" .dst_labels }}remote-node{{ else }}{{ .dst_ip }}{{ end }}`
  | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__.UnixMilli }}`
  | keep verdict, dir, source, destination, port, policy, ts
  | unwrap ts [$__range]
)
